# ITD System Monitoring and Optimization Guidelines

This document details essential monitoring and optimization tasks for maintaining robust IT infrastructure:

*   Monitor encryption standards quarterly.
*   Optimize API latency quarterly.
*   Monitor firewall settings for standard updates.
*   Investigate database migration based on audit findings.
*   Review API latency based on audit findings.
